description:
Act as a medical imaging data curator. The CT Cranium dataset is already loaded. Create a standardized teaching project with exactly three segmentation masks for different tissues. 

1. Create a Bone mask (threshold ~200+ HU), rename it to 'Standard_Bone', and set its color to White.
2. Create a Skin/Soft Tissue mask (threshold approx -600 to 200 HU), rename it to 'Standard_Skin', and set its color to Pink or Red.
3. Create an Air mask (threshold < -400 HU), rename it to 'Standard_Air', and set its color to Blue or Cyan.

Save the project to '/home/ga/Documents/teaching_head.inv3'.
